metaDescription: Order custom rush non adhesive items for quick delivery. Perfect for last-minute events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need branded non-woven tote bags fast, our rush production option cuts standard lead times to meet tight deadlines. Non-woven polypropylene totes like the Non-Woven Tote Bag and Non-Woven Grocery Tote are lightweight, durable, and ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or event swag. With rush service, you can still get screen-printed logos on these eco-friendly bags without the wait. Perfect for marketing directors and event planners who need quality promotional products on an accelerated schedule.
heroAltText: Custom rush non adhesive non-woven tote bags with screen-printed logos for quick delivery
